description: This file defines the 'ActivateTrigger' class, a Unity script used to handle trigger-based actions in a game environment. It provides multiple modes for triggering actions on target game objects when a collider enters the trigger zone.

classes.name: ActivateTrigger
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour script that performs various actions on target objects when a trigger collider is entered.

methods.name: DoActivateTrigger
methods.description: Handles the activation logic based on the selected mode when the trigger is activated.

methods.name: OnTriggerEnter
methods.description: Unity event method called when another collider enters the trigger collider; invokes activation logic.
